name: chess-rook
description: A complete chess rook with three battlements and a broad base.
useCase: Choose or identify a rook in a chess interface.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: Both open crown slots stay clear above the complete tapered body and full base.

24.reason: The larger rook keeps all three battlements, both full crown slots and the complete body and base.
